name: Keturah Lamoreaux

residences.place: Luzerne Co. ('Caturah Akley', head of household)

bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Keturah the dates 18 Feb 1791 to 9 Dec 1842 and her marriage to Samuel Ackley on 18 Jun 1815. Its attached 1830 census entry is indexed under 'Caturah Akley' as head of household (S1).
